GET /api/containers/{containerId}: No 'container get'; 'container list' and 'container stats' show a container's details.
GET /api/containers/by-name/{name}: Called only to turn a --container name into an id; no 'container get' shows the result.
GET /api/containers/{containerId}/settin: No command for per-container settings yet.
PUT /api/containers/{containerId}/settin: No command for per-container settings yet.
DELETE /api/containers/{containerId}/set: No command for per-container settings yet.
POST /api/containers/{containerId}/retry: No 'container retry-failed' yet; 'source retry-failed' covers sources.
POST /api/containers/{containerId}/sync: No 'container sync' yet; 'source sync' covers sources.
GET /api/containers/{containerId}/files/: 'files get' reads a file's content; no command shows its metadata alone.
No command lists a file's links yet.
POST /api/containers/{containerId}/files: 'files delete' takes several files through the delete_file MCP tool, which the server holds for approval; the REST bulk delete has no command.
No command reads several files' contents in one call yet; 'files get' reads one.
GET /api/containers/{containerId}/files/: No command checks whether one file needs reindexing yet.
POST /api/containers/{containerId}/files: No command retries one failed file yet.
POST /api/containers/{containerId}/folde: No 'folder create' yet; 'upload' creates folders implicitly.
GET /api/batches/{id}/status: 'upload' doesn't report on its ingestion batch yet.
POST /api/containers/{containerId}/searc: 'search' uses the GET form of container search; the POST form takes the same query in a body.
GET /api/containers/{containerId}/search: No command lists a container's embedding models; 'settings embedding-models' lists them across all containers.
POST /api/sources/{sourceId}/search: 'search' searches containers only; no command searches one source yet.
GET /api/memory/spaces: Called only to turn a --space name into an id; no 'memory space list' yet.
POST /api/memory/spaces: No 'memory space create' yet, so a script can't make a space to save into.
PUT /api/memory/spaces/{spaceId}/star: No command stars a memory space yet.
DELETE /api/memory/spaces/{spaceId}/star: No command unstars a memory space yet.

GET /api/memory/spaces/{id}/subjects: No command lists a space's subjects yet.
